exclusionRules.evaluationDatasetAdmits: only designated scheduled states (C1 harness states; C2 QLS states)
excludedButPreserved: v1 outcome rows (intraday target, base before/at state, day-keyed)
V3-H shadow engine rows (separate experimental engine)
exclusionRules.preservation: Rows are never deleted or modified; exclusions.json lists ids, timestamps, provenance and reason; later exclusions are appended in a new versioned file, never overwriting this one.

sets.contamination: Engine was designed in 2026 with knowledge of this period; diagnostic, cannot alone support PASS.
sets.expectedN: 738 XNYS sessions (counted from the ^GSPC bar calendar, no FAULTLINE data); N_eff = N/h: 1d 738, 5d 147, 10d 73, 21d 35, 63d 11, 126d 5, 252d 2
sets.label: RETROSPECTIVE_RECONSTRUCTION (not a validated backtest)
sets.name: Faithful-input historical reconstruction
sets.rule: All 8 engine inputs from ALFRED vintages; no proxies, no fallback constants (state INPUT_UNAVAILABLE if any series missing). Engine code executed unchanged at 1cfa129 with an injected fetch layer replaying vintages in engine.ts FRED_SERIES order/limits.

sets.checkpoints: Descriptive interim reports allowed monthly without verdict. Verdict computed once, when >= 630 QLS states have matured 21d outcomes (approx. 2029); earlier verdict only MIXED-INCONCLUSIVE by rule.
sets.label: FORWARD_LIVE
sets.name: Live forward record (only untouched holdout)
sets.rule: QLS vf-qls-v1: scheduled 18:00 UTC cron, manifest generatedAt in [18:00,18:30) UTC, NYSE trading day, earliest qualifying row per ET market date, hash integrity. Primary sensitivity: only states with runProvenance.codeVersion = 1cfa129 (first possible: 2026-10-05).

sets.label: EXPLORATORY_PROXY (separate test id FL-HV-2026-10-04-002 must be pre-registered before it is run)
sets.name: Proxy reconstruction 2001-01-02 .. 2023-10-03
sets.rule: HY OAS proxy = OLS map of BAA10Y onto HY OAS fitted on 2023-10-03..2026-09-14 input data only; SOFR proxy = DFF before 2018-04-02; DGS10/DGS2 before 2005-06-28 = earliest-vintage values (label EARLIEST_VINTAGE_BACKFILL). No verdict weight in this test id.

timing.engineQuirksReproduced: latestValid with limit 2 returns fallback if both obs are "." (holiday); CPI/PPI YoY use obs[12] positionally; HY conversion x100 if <=20. In C1 a fallback is not allowed (INPUT_UNAVAILABLE); sensitivity FALLBACK_AS_PRODUCTION uses engine constants.

inputAvailability.market: latest completed close = previous session (and early-close same session only if completedAt < evalTime)
inputAvailability.primary: FRED/ALFRED value usable at D iff its vintage realtime_start < D (calendar), i.e. next day after release; conservative because the state precedes most afternoon FRED updates
inputAvailability.sensitivity: SAME_DAY_RELEASE: for HY OAS, SOFR and VIXCLS (morning publication) allow realtime_start = D

timing.observedAtTreatment: Prod observedAt is null; historical observedAt := evalTime of the designated state; per-input availability recorded as the ALFRED realtime_start of the vintage used. Never back-filled into prod.
timing.stateGeneration: One designated state per XNYS session D at 18:00:00 UTC (= 14:00 ET under EDT, 13:00 ET under EST; mirrors prod cron 0 18 * * *). No state on non-sessions. Reruns never replace a designated state.
timing.stateRecord: Each evaluated state stores stateId, runId, evalTime (UTC ISO), engine SHA, formulaHash, methodology hash, input snapshot id (sha256 of the vintage set), per-series realtime_start, and set label (C1/C2/E1).
timing.unavailableHistoricalInputs: UNAVAILABLE for that period; no proxy without separate documentation and sensitivity label; counted and reported.
